scope: four fictional NPC portraits, no real-person reference; visual working designs only

sources.name: 唐萤
sources.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: an individual fictional NPC portrait for a Chinese narrative life-and-business game, Reborn 2020 AI Era. Premium semi-realistic cinematic painted portrait, natural facial anatomy with fine brush texture, restrained editorial realism rather than a photograph, anime or 3D render. Vertical 4:5 composition, chest-up, one person only, face near the upper middle with ample room around hair, subtle three-quarter angle and calm engaged gaze. No hands in frame. Soft warm interior light with a cool window rim, muted forest green, umber and cream palette, matte finish, subtle fine film grain. Background is a softly defocused ordinary urban interior in China around 2020, visually simple and quiet. The character is wholly invented and must not resemble a real public figure. All portraits in this set must look like the same illustrator and the same game world. Avoid glamour advertising, luxury, excessive beauty retouching, cyberpunk, neon, sci-fi props, caricature, logos, signatures, watermarks, frames and all text or lettering. The image contains no game UI or numbers. Output a clean high-resolution vertical 4:5 portrait suitable for a framed character card.
Character-specific visual design: An invented Chinese woman in her late twenties with a softly angular face, warm dark eyes and a short natural black bob tucked behind one ear. A simple oatmeal knit top and a muted terracotta cardigan. Relaxed thoughtful expression, a slight unforced smile, independent and grounded rather than a romantic glamour pose. Soft ordinary cafe/window background without visible branding. No occupational badge or implied specific job.
